title: Contraflow Cyclist at a Parking-Garage Exit
requiredTopology: garage ramp crossing sidewalk and bike lane

acceptance.rule: ego starts stopped and stops again for the contraflow rider
ego creep speed is at most 5 kph
ego occupies no more than 0.3 m of the bike lane before final entry
ego observes for at least 1 second after the contraflow rider passes
minimum cyclist clearance is at least 1.5 m

forbidden: look only in the legal direction
